headline: Argentina Sovereign Bonds Fall as Country Risk Exceeds 850 Points
summary: Argentina's country risk surpassed 850 points, reaching a new yearly high as sovereign bonds decline across both US and local markets.
why: Sovereign risk indicators reflect investor perception of a country's creditworthiness and directly impact its borrowing costs and the valuation of its government debt.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Rising country risk and falling bond prices indicate declining valuation for Argentine sovereign debt.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: An increase in country risk and falling bond prices reflect heightened investor concern over sovereign debt stability.
